name: Phone gallery grid sets up the headline
looks: A phone's photo gallery grid shows a dozen ordinary selfies, several already checkmark-selected; beside it a huge two-line headline states what the viewer is looking at, with a small caption underneath grounding it in something everyday ("the ones already on your phone").
build: Device screenshot is static, the headline fades/rises in as one block (`y:10px -> 0`, power2.out, ~300ms) a beat after the screenshot settles; the small caption beneath types or fades in last, in a quieter weight.
sound: A soft low swell under the headline's arrival, a faint camera-shutter tick as the checkmarks appear on the selected photos.
prompt: Pair a real device screenshot of an ordinary photo grid, a few items already selected, with a huge two-line headline that names what's being shown, and a small grounding caption underneath in a quieter weight, so the everyday input feels deliberately chosen rather than generic.
